title: Economizer Initiative: Modular Savings Runbook & Rollout Plan
creator: Lena Korhonen
description: Purpose: Create an operational runbook and staged rollout plan for a modular savings feature-set (adaptive batching, prefix/KV caching lifecycle, and conservative quantization profiles). This ticket tracks the product deliverables, gating criteria, and cross-functional work needed to ship a guarded, measurable cost-optimization capability that customers can opt into per-model or per-route.
acceptance_criteria: A documented runbook with step-by-step canary procedure (guardrail checks + rollback steps)
Automated evaluation harness that compares quality (BLEU/ROUGE/semantic similarity + human spot checks) between baseline and savings profiles on three representative workloads
Dashboard showing per-model cost delta, latency percentile, and quality regressions with alerts configured
Canary rollout succeeds across >=3 internal production-like traffic slices with no >1% customer-facing error increase and quality delta within agreed thresholds
milestones: 2025-02-24: Instrumentation and dashboard prototype linked to cost observability (done)
2025-05-10: Public opt-in beta for select customers (planned)
success_metrics: Primary OKR: reduce hosted per-token inference cost by 9-12% across participating models within 90 days of GA
Latency SLO preservation: P95 increase <= 10ms on average for routes in the savings cohort
Quality guardrail: automated semantic-similarity delta <= 1.5% and manual review rate < 2% of responses
Adoption: at least 8 production customers opt into the beta within 30 days
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: unexpected quality regressions on long-context prompts — Mitigation: limit quant profiles to conservative quantization for L > 2048 tokens and add automatic rollback triggers
Risk: tail-latency spikes when batching merges heterogeneous seq lengths — Mitigation: adaptive batch window + per-route max-latency cap
Risk: KV cache invalidation complexity causing stale outputs — Mitigation: TTL policies, per-model cache diagnostics, and a cache-health dashboard
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (lab): run private experiments with synthetic traffic and offline evals
Phase 1 (internal canary): enable on internal non-customer routes with telemetry and alerting
Phase 2 (customer beta): opt-in for low-risk customers and provide playbook + opt-out support
Phase 3 (GA): enable per-account recommendations in Console with toggle and cost-preview estimates
